title: Band-9 Samples: What kind of pictures do you like having in your home? [Why?]
content:
This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 12 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 4 Test 4 question:

“What kind of pictures do you like having in your home? [Why?]”

Sample 1

Well, to be perfectly frank, I don’t pay much attention to the artwork adorning my walls. The reason for this is simple – I’m not particularly moved by visual stimuli. I prefer to surround myself with items that have functional value rather than aesthetic appeal.

Sample 2

In this digital age, I find myself less inclined to display pictures around my home. I prefer to keep my photos digital and often view them on screens rather than in physical frames. This way, I can have countless images at my fingertips without cluttering my living space.

Sample 3

Given my hectic schedule as a corporate lawyer, I rarely find time to contemplate the kind of artwork or pictures I want in my home. Honestly, I’m usually too exhausted to pay much attention to it. My home serves as a place to unwind and disconnect from work, not an art gallery.

Sample 4

I’m quite partial to having paintings and illustrations around my home, especially those with an abstract theme. They tend to be conversation starters, stirring up interesting interpretations and viewpoints from people. It’s fascinating how such visuals can provoke thought and evoke emotions, adding a layer of depth and complexity to the aesthetics of my home.

Sample 5

The walls of my home are adorned with pictures from my travels. Every image tells a story of an adventure, a unique culture, or a remarkable encounter. They’re visual reminders of the experiences I’ve had, the places I’ve seen, and the people I’ve met. It’s a wonderful way to keep my wanderlust alive and rekindle memories of my journeys.

Sample 6

I prefer having portraits of individuals who have significantly influenced my life. These could be renowned authors, scientists, or even historical figures. Their presence in my home serves as a daily inspiration, constantly reminding me of their contributions to society and the relentless pursuit of their goals, despite the challenges they encountered.

Sample 7

Landscape photographs, particularly those portraying the breathtaking beauty of nature, are my cup of tea. Whether it’s a tranquil beach scene or a majestic mountain range, they have an inherent soothing quality that, I believe, helps to create a peaceful ambiance in my living space. It’s like having a window to different corners of the world, right in my own home.

Sample 8

I enjoy having images of my personal achievements on display, such as photos from graduation ceremonies, or snapshots from the moment I received an award. These images aren’t just about showcasing success, they also serve as a testament to the hard work, dedication, and resilience that went behind each achievement. They motivate me to continue striving for excellence.

Sample 9

I have a deep admiration for botanical prints. Their intricate details and the elegance they add to my space are truly appealing. They not only brighten up my home but their presence also kindles an appreciation for the beauty and diversity of plant life. Plus, they harmonize wonderfully with my indoor plant collection.

Sample 10

A major part of my home’s charm comes from pictures of my pets. Images of their playful moments, lazy afternoons, or even their mischievous exploits add a personal and lively touch to my living space. It’s a delightful way to celebrate their companionship and the joy they bring into my life, making my home feel truly complete.
